description: The pie chart presents the distribution of relation categories in the MMRA benchmark, showing 11 slices in total, each labeled with a count and percentage directly on or near the slice and without a separate legend. The slices are: ObservationAngle in green at 126 (12.28%); SimilarMaterial in mustard/brown at 106 (10.33%); SubEvent in muted red at 100 (9.74%); UsageSimilarity in brownish-red at 100 (9.65%); Environment in dark teal at 90 (8.77%); Layout in beige at 90 (8.77%); AppearanceSimilarity in gray-green at 90 (8.77%); SimilarEvent in blue-gray at 90 (8.77%); MentalitySimilarity in teal-gray at 89 (8.67%); RelativePosition in gray at 81 (7.90%); and NearSameEntity in dark gray at 63 (6.34%). No slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the segments do not appear strictly ordered by size around the circle.
